newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA MARCH TRADE BALANCE SHOWS $33.9 MLN SURPLUS.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA MARCH TRADE BALANCE SHOWS $33.9 MLN SURPLUS.

text.p: Romania's trade balance had a
$33.9 million surplus in March, recovering from $51.9 million
deficit the previous month, helped by a 6.8 percent drop in
imports, National Statistic Board (CNS) data showed.
This is the first time when Romania's trade balance shows a
monthly surplus since last September, when it posted $6.2
million in surplus.
Romania's exports rose by 6.1 percent from the previous
month, but were 3.2 percent down year on year, a CNS report
said on Friday.
Over January-March, exports inched down by 1.1 percent from
the same period of 1996 to $1.9 billion. Textiles and steel
products topped the list of three-month exports.
March's imports amounted to $644.8 million, with
three-month imports showing a 10.3 percent drop from the
equivalent period of last year at $2.1 billion.
The January-March trade balance showed a gap of $184.6
million.
